title: Google tells marketers to retire the Top 10 post
intro: In a Nov 19 Think with Google piece, Google said generic listicles are the weak content costing brands visibility, in regular search and in AI answers. AI answers also picked up new jobs this week: ChatGPT opened business profiles (one jeweler's first 28 days brought six site visits, a small sample), Microsoft started running ads inside Bing AI Overviews, and AI tools began showing coupon codes right in the answer. Closer to home, a two-location HVAC company found Google had quietly blocked its new reviews for weeks, and with Black Friday days away, now is the time to check that your cookie banner still blocks the tags it says it blocks.
